Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
sylvain Gogel wrote:
> When can i play the reaction/Combat card Reform Body?

When you are being burned in combat and/or when an acting minion
controlled by another Methuselah is burning you (when he is
taking the 'Encounter in Torpor to Diablerize' action, for example).
